class.name: NavigationTraversalProfile3D
class.brief_description: Describes which traversal surfaces a kind of creature can use and how expensive they are.
class.description: A profile is one entry of [member NavigationTraversalRules3D.profiles]. Every accepted traversal surface stores the [member layer_bit] of each profile that can use it in its [code]layers[/code] mask (see [member NavigationMesh.traversal_surfaces]). A path query selects profiles with [member NavigationPathQueryParameters3D.traversal_layers]. Height ranges are stored as [Vector2]: [member Vector2.x] is the minimum and [member Vector2.y] the maximum height in meters. Angles are in degrees.

method.name: get_enter_cost
method.description: Returns the extra path cost of a traversal that takes [param duration] seconds and spans [param length] meters of path: [code]max(0, duration * time_scale + extra_penalty - length)[/code].

method.name: get_height_range
method.description: Returns the allowed height range of [param kind].

method.name: is_height_in_range
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param height] lies within the height range of [param kind], inclusive.

method.name: is_kind_allowed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param kind] is enabled in [member allowed_kinds].

method.name: set_height_range
method.description: Sets the allowed height range of [param kind].

method.name: set_kind_allowed
method.description: Enables or disables [param kind] in [member allowed_kinds].

members.member: Traversal kinds this profile can perform. Bit [code]n[/code] corresponds to [enum TraversalKind] value [code]n[/code].
Height range of a ledge that can be climbed onto, from the approach floor to the top floor.
Height range of a thin wall that can be climbed over when there is no room to stand on top.
Height range of a drop that can be stepped off without hanging from the edge.
Constant cost added to every traversal of this profile. See [method get_enter_cost].
Height range of a drop that requires hanging from the edge before letting go.
Unique profile identifier, for example [code]&"hero"[/code]. Used by [method NavigationTraversalRules3D.get_profile].

Bit index (0 to 31) of this profile in the traversal layer mask. It is set explicitly so adding or renaming profiles never changes the bits of baked surfaces. Must be unique within one [NavigationTraversalRules3D].
Maximum horizontal distance between the approach point and the exit point.
Maximum angle in degrees between the faces under the two hand grips.
Maximum offset of the two hand grips along the traversal direction.
Maximum floor height difference between both sides of a vaulted or climbed-over obstacle.
Maximum floor slope in degrees at the approach and exit points.
Maximum thickness of a vaulted or climbed-over obstacle along the traversal direction.
Path cost per second of traversal. Usually the profile's reference walking speed. See [method get_enter_cost].
Height range of a low obstacle that can be vaulted, measured from the approach floor to its crest.
